content:

Main only; every step is deferred, none ran here.
1. Review all seven Python sources, source audit, production pins, qualification schema and this source contract.
2. Under the shared measurement lock, qualify pure malformed-parser/pending-admission cases and the actual
   qualified-owner mock GEN16/QUIT session using controller_cpu_fixtures.py. Add subprocess tests proving invalid
   qualification/health/sequence/immutable pins never launch a real engine and never import the owner on pending
   admission; add mapping identity/malformed ELF/byte-budget and hostile protocol fixtures if needed. Record
   actual owned closure and parser_malformed_fixtures_passed, owned_mock_quit_passed, invalid_admission_prelaunch_passed and invalid_pending_process_passed. The child traps any owner import
   attempt, requires no real campaign namespace and proves actual pending rejection under owned supervision.
3. Create NEW Main actual controller CPU and immutable source-review receipts with the seven v4 controller hashes.
   No old controller qualification applies to this packet or these pristine binaries.
4. Resolve qualification.pending.json into a NEW actual admission receipt after actual build/CPU qualification.
   Build receipts must contain actual inference ELF/source pins/compiler_provider, not an old component BUILD.json.
   Xe must confirm backend=xe and strata_enable_sycl=false. R211 supersedes R209's legacy-SYCL branch statements;
   confirm real separate copy queue/event handoffs, segmented verifier, and explicitly review ignored intermediate
   event/copy return handling. Preserve immutability; no source fixes are included in this controller packet.
5. Independently qualify provider-native health binaries for Xe LLVM7.1.1 and official installed icpx2026.1.
   Resolve exact health/self-map and model-runtime/driver/compiler/stdlib/math identities, SHA/stat/GNU ELF build IDs.
   Force ONLY each engine's own provider/lib/libur_adapter_level_zero_v2.so.0.12.0; retain NEO debug1,
   direct submission0 and V2 copy offload disable1. No foreign adapter; required model runtime paths include actual libsycl and L0 adapter. Resolve actual
   /opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1/lib and at most4 necessary /opt/intel/oneapi/tbb/* search dirs for official.
   Health uses the SAME fully explicit environment as that engine/phase; startup debug versus model warning.
   The probe must provide the six exact integer-completion lines followed only by LIBRARY absolute-path lines.
6. Do NOT pre-pin expert_slots in qualification. Startup records its positive bounded actual plan; model binds
   that engine's successful sameboot Main-reviewed startup plan. Resolve selected device/backend stderr identity.
   Use the fixed argv; no MTP/native experimental add-ons, no batching/pipeline windows, suffix/chain/caches off.
   Create a NEW model identity receipt certifying existing exact canonical pack/native/PLE/profile full hashes and
   unchanged stat identities. Its model_inputs are sorted PACK/MODEL regular file paths plus PROFILE last, excluding
   MTP directory. A successful old hash phase may be referenced as immutable data evidence only, without rewriting
   its original failed overall receipt and without treating it as new-binary qualification.
7. Before EACH run, Main supplies a new fresh-health receipt with successful anchored commands, current boot,
   selected index0/one Level Zero GPU, PCI0000:05:00.0, normal state, device_used_mib<=256, fresh kernel gate,
   actual provider health binary/libraries/protocol and matching explicit command environment. Its finished UTC
   must be at most120s before controller admission. For a model run include Main's startup_review pin: passed,
   main_reviewed, exact predecessor_sha256, compile_diagnostics_reviewed and provider_identity_reviewed true.
8. Fixed run order: xe-startup -> xe-model -> official-startup -> official-model in the NEW private namespace.
   Controller takes the measurement lock itself. Do not retain an outer incompatible flock when delegating to it.
   No retry/adoption: an existing failed/incomplete root blocks the campaign. Each model's own normally QUIT
   closed startup must be same boot and same exact qualification. Every preceding root must be successful.
9. Main records every status/sample and exact fingerprint, stderr/journal messages and retention decision.
   No speed/fit/quality/RESTORE/full-logit claim from startup or this GEN16 fingerprint. Later optimization and
   full arithmetic parity are separate gates. Retire successful full logs only after Main compact extraction/review;
   preserve the last diagnostic for any unresolved mechanism. Controller performs no cleanup/deletion.

CPU recipe for Main under owned serialized supervision, never executed by implementer:
/usr/bin/python3 -B controller_cpu_fixtures.py
/usr/bin/python3 -B controller_cpu_fixtures.py --owned-mock-output <NEW_B_CPU_MOCK_DIRECTORY> \
  --invalid-pending-output <NEW_B_CPU_PENDING_DIRECTORY>

Actual model controller arguments, placeholders deliberately non-executable until Main resolves all receipts:
/usr/bin/python3 -B run_root.py --engine <xe|official> --phase <startup|model> \
  --qualification <NEW_ACTUAL_RECEIPT> --qualification-sha256 <ACTUAL_SHA256> \
  --fresh-health <NEW_SAMEBOOT_FRESH_RECEIPT> --fresh-health-sha256 <ACTUAL_SHA256>

V2 boundary review: R215/R216 fully read. Requested ring8 clamps>=16 at8K, issuer0 retained against known
threaded skip-entry publication race. Review READY stderr offset/partial-line handling and strict post-READY
classification: no compile-word exemption of unrelated runtime enums, and no post-READY build-error exemption.

Main v4 derivative: exact SHA/stat/mapped identity remains mandatory, optional GNU build-ID absence is explicit. Selected device source regex uses actual qualified name and records observed metrics. Installed UMF1.1 and compiler opt/compiler/lib search paths are included. Utility XDG/DBUS allowlist supports read-only user-service state. No model run yet.

Main derivation: independent official-only namespace; mandatory --prefill8; model/controller wall3600s, CPU bounded by affinity*wall+60, progress rows bounded bywall/30+4. Active GEN receives supported STOP with90s normal-close reserve. Original failed/canceled arms remain unchanged; no pristine engine source changes.
